title: test_tofu_capacity_rejects_active_session_saturation fails on HEAD: receive returns CAPACITY_EXHAUSTED, test expects REPLAY
description: Pre-existing deterministic failure on HEAD (verified by stashing unrelated jqa9 fix): python/tests/schc/test_fragment.py::test_tofu_capacity_rejects_active_session_saturation_until_hold_down_expires fails at line 2404: asyncio.run(link.receive(100)) returns ReceiveError.CAPACITY_EXHAUSTED (9) but test asserts ReceiveError.REPLAY (7). Log: 'RX TOFU pin capacity exhausted; failing closed' (link_layer.py:1654). The test saturates 64 TOFU pin slots with active fragment senders, cancels sender[0], then expects the pinned-out newcomer frame to be REPLAY-rejected at now=0.0 and 59.999 and admitted at hold-down expiry now=60.0. First queue_rx already returns CAPACITY_EXHAUSTED, so the RX pin-budget accounting (ReplayProtector max_peers=64 + _pinned_keys) rejects the 65th peer before replay-floor logic. Likely test expectation or pin-budget precheck ordering drifted in the 660b9bf3bf link-layer security commit. NOT caused by project-LICHEN-worker6-jqa9 fix (verified via stash). Bead jqa9's known-flaky note undersold this: it fails in isolation too.
